source: Independent adversarial review of the strict transition matcher.
scope: Matcher-only support attribution. No engine, world construction, branch rendering, or acceptance denominator behavior may change.

review_failures.problem: The branch-local support pool unions the selected actor's normal and critical bases without conditioning on the selected branch's |-crit| marker. This can accept a Showdown critical damage against a noncritical engine branch, or the inverse.
review_failures.required_fix: Record criticality for the selected direct-damage protocol event and derive legal support from only its normal or critical base.
controls: An observed critical component cannot match a noncritical engine event.
An observed noncritical component cannot match a critical engine event.
A critical marker for another hit cannot select support for the chosen direct event.

review_failures.problem: Target-side support applies the selected direct-hit range to every rolled component on that side, allowing the selected hit's range to legalize confusion, recoil, drain, or another same-side HP event.
review_failures.required_fix: Carry the selected direct-damage protocol event identity and apply rebuilt support only to that exact component; every other component keeps its pre-state range.
controls: A confusion self-hit cannot borrow direct-hit support.
Recoil, drain, and other tagged same-side components cannot borrow direct-hit support.
The existing switch, stat-event, Spikes, and Substitute HP-cost controls remain unchanged.

success_criteria: The matcher fails closed when it cannot identify the selected direct event or its criticality.
Corpus reread reports retained-row identity changes and critical-marker consistency, not only aggregate match counts.
No final artifact contains host-local absolute paths.
